column1: # Fixtures whose forced-JIT run installs no native entry, with the admission
# reason GOS_JIT_TRACE reports. Read by `tier_parity`: a fixture NOT listed here
# must install at least one native entry, otherwise its "cranelift" parity row
# is a second bytecode-VM run. A listed fixture that starts compiling fails the
# walk as a stale row - shrinking this file is the point.
#   admission gate        excluded by the admission gate for another reason
#   aggregate print       renders a `Vec` of a user aggregate, whose derived
#                         `fmt` is a bytecode body with no native address to
#   aggregate ref arg     passes a `&Vec<T>` / `&mut Vec<T>` the admission gate
#                         cannot lower at the call boundary
#   &mut aggregate param  a `&mut` aggregate parameter the trampoline cannot
#   bytecode-only local   body holds another local repr the JIT cannot lower
#   callable local        body holds a closure / fn-pointer local (the JIT has
#   cross-goroutine       spawns a goroutine or touches a channel / sync object
#   entry shape           every compiled body failed the entry-shape gate
#   no hot body           no loop or recursion reaches the promotion threshold
#   no hot user body      only compiler-injected bodies reached the gate at all;
#                         nothing the program itself declares became hot
#   string append         appends string bytes in place
#   unlowerable local     a local the lowering itself refuses
#   unlowered call        calls a name with no proven native lowering
# A reason names a body the program runs. An injected `__gos_serde_*` body is
# refused in nearly every program that declares a struct, and it reports first,
# so reading the first `jit: unsupported` line credits the fixture to a body
# nothing calls - which is how the largest category here came to overstate
# and read only the lines that name a body the program declares.

column2: unsupported-boundary: a struct carrying two-word Option/Result fields crosses the function boundary, which the trampoline cannot marshal - the shape the fixture exists to pin
